interpretation: Read-only snapshot of active GameObjects under a Canvas at screenshot request time. Disabled Image/TMP components are included and marked. clickable is a component/CanvasGroup/raycast-graphic estimate; no clicks or overlay occlusion raycasts are performed. The PNG is captured at Unity's next frame end.
